reader.requirement: At --std 85 every key word (uppercase and underlined in a COBOL-85 general format) must be written whenever its format is used, so a statement, clause or entry that omits one is refused, while the format's optional (not underlined) words may be left out, judged by the 1985 underlining where it differs from a later edition's.

edition-consulted.switches: the grammar lets BY be omitted (2002+ form); below COBOL-2002 a VARYING phrase with no BY is refused (COBOL0900), BY being underlined in the 1985 PERFORM format
the same for an AFTER phrase with no BY
below COBOL-2002 a USE ... EXCEPTION/ERROR without AFTER or without PROCEDURE is refused (both underlined in §1985:VII.4.6.2)

reader.edition-search: Ran python scripts/spec/audit_grammar_optional_words.py --edition 1985 (reads the 1985 formats from the transcription's decided drawings): 215 formats measured, 0 candidates, and 13 DECIDED rows naming where a word the grammar admits omitted or repeated is refused later, of which PERFORM BY (twice) and USE AFTER/PROCEDURE are the 1985 edition arms above and SUBTRACT FROM is ArithmeticBinder.BindSubtract at every edition. Rendered PDF page 198 (§1985 V-6) to confirm RECORD KEY IS has KEY not underlined, matching the grammar's RECORD KEY? IS?.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: PERFORM VARYING/AFTER without BY and USE without AFTER or PROCEDURE are refused at 85 and accepted at 2023 (later editions made those words optional)

reader.notes: The rule is carried by the shared grammar (a key word is a demanded token) plus, where the grammar admits a later edition's omission, a COBOL0900 gate at 85; the 1985 audit of every drawn format reports no omissible key word left unrefused. The probes sample statements, data and file entries; they do not visit every one of the 215 formats.

refuter.evidence: Read the 1985 formats for CALL, ALTER, START, OPEN/CLOSE, ADD, PROGRAM-ID, OBJECT-COMPUTER, IF. Omitted key word refused at --std 85 (refute-1985-042/src/kw): o04 ON SIZE without ERROR, o05 ON ERROR without SIZE, o06 ALTER P1 PROCEED TO P2 (first TO), o07 SET IX UP 1 (BY), o08 START G > G-K (KEY), o09 CLOSE F WITH NO (REWIND), o11 SIGN LEADING CHARACTER (SEPARATE), o12 OCCURS 1 TO 3 TIMES ON N-A (DEPENDING), o13 CALL USING BY N-A (REFERENCE/CONTENT), o14 PERFORM WITH BEFORE (TEST), o15 DISPLAY WITH NO (ADVANCING), o18 INSPECT REPLACING ALL "A" "B" (BY), o19 CONVERTING without TO, m MEMORY SIZE 100 without WORDS/CHARACTERS/MODULES; o22 NOT GREATER THAN OR EQUAL refused (not a 1985 relational operator).
